name: newhorizons.graphics
description: The graphics of the English DOS release (New Horizons). The files are LS10 and LS11 containers, whose codec is documented in the importer. The geometry of each file is a property of the file and not of the container, so it is stated here. KAO.LZW holds the portraits of the characters, 64 by 80 pixels in three planes, one portrait to a block. PORTCHIP.LZW holds the material of the ports, sixteen by sixteen tiles in four planes, thirty tiles to a block.
